title: Editor layout is still loaded when starting the editor with the `--headless` command line argument
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.rc1

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc1 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.11037.4004) - AMD Ryzen Threadripper 7970X 32-Cores (64 threads)

### Issue description

Exporting with --headless will attempt to open the editor layout. This in turn does other steps such as loading scenes, and other unnecessary steps right before finishing.

### Steps to reproduce

- Download project
- `setx GODOT_EXEC path/to/godot/console/editor` (or just replace this line in `test\builds\BuildGame.bat`)
- Run BuildGame.bat
Observe that the layout is loaded at the end of the output:
```
loading_editor_layout: begin: Loading editor steps: 5
        loading_editor_layout: step 0: Loading editor layout...
        loading_editor_layout: step 1: Loading docks...
        loading_editor_layout: step 2: Reopening scenes...
        loading_editor_layout: step 3: Loading central editor layout...
        loading_editor_layout: step 4: Loading plugin window layout...
        loading_editor_layout: step 5: Editor layout ready.
loading_editor_layout: end
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18974745/test.zip)
